entry.focal: A squat 4x4x1 m orange box (the vent) in the centre, ringed by grey boulder and seat boxes. The upper 60% of the frame is black vault.
entry.next_visible: Weakly. Right of frame, the b3_lazy hero box (orange) sits across the channel; nothing signals the south bridge or the slide cave.

reveal.focal: The overexposed slide-shaft cylinder at the left, which is far brighter than the vent box in the centre.
reveal.next_visible: Yes, too strongly: the slide shaft pulls the eye east, away from the hero.

concept.focal: The vent box fills the bottom third as a flat brown slab. The upper frame is empty black, with the spiral stair and lantern row at the left.
concept.next_visible: Only the B3 lobby spiral stair at the left. There is no plume to look up at.

strip.focal: Lantern slabs and grey boxes scattered at even density round the loop. In frame 3 a 3 m grey block (pine_bonsai) fills the left half.
strip.next_visible: Partly. The amber dotted line of the far stair is visible in frames 5 and 6.

fixes.detail: Replace the opaque 4x4x1 box with a low mound (r 2.2, h 0.6-1.0) plus an emissive teal plume proxy column (r ~1.0, h 14) and 6 minor columns (r 0.3-0.5, h 4-8). The space has no vertical focal point and no brightest object; concept 14 is all plume.
pool_uplight ring radius [1.5,4.0] puts most of the 7 uplights inside the 2 m half-width hero box, so the pool never glows. Put one under each vent on the mound and the rest at radius [2.6,5.0].

lantern_niche is a wall asset; snapped to the open deck it becomes 12 free-standing 1 m white slabs that are the brightest objects on the island. Replace them with low light strips under or behind each seat block (concept 14), or with lantern_floor at dim 0.5.
pine_bonsai (2.6x2.6x3.2) at (129.2,44.0) reads as a 3 m wall beside the east loop of the spine (strip-3). Move it toward the island tip, behind the walk.
Cross-space: the floor-snapped lava_tube box across the channel is visible from the island (entry right, strip-5) as an unexplained orange block. See the b3_lazy review.

top_change: Give the vent a 14 m emissive teal plume proxy and uplights that are not buried inside the hero box, so the brightest, tallest thing in the cavern is actually the geyser.
plausibility: Most of the pool uplights sit inside the 4x4 m hero proxy.
The pool water is indistinguishable from the deck at eye level, so the seat ring appears to surround dry floor.
From this island, the slide-shaft cylinder 36 m away is brighter than the vent.
